content.description:
Walkers is a Cardano NFT project with Game Fi elements, utilizing the move 2 earn model rewarding holders for the distance they have walked. Walker's holders will be rewarded for any distance walked.

Walkers is a project that promotes a healthy lifestyle and gameFi experience through using the Walkers app. WalkersCNFT holders will be able to gain experiance and earn points which will then be available to swap for $WALKERS token which will be listed on Cardano DEXs.

WalkersCNFT story begins in the year 3030 where the walkers are lost in a labyrinth struggling to find a way out. This is a Cyberpunk style inspired story and all art and design is based around that.

Main parts of interests in users:

Main collection consist four types of CHARACTERS: Man, Women, Hybrids and Super naturals with more then 250 traits. In future phases of the projects product of breeding will be Children Art is in cyberpunk style with detailed design on traits. The COMIC BOOK is part of Walkers IP too. The comic is LORE based and describes the life of the characters in the labyrinth. The comic book cover metadata will be integrated with MUSIC made by blockchain music artists in production of blockchain music production studio.

With Walk2Earn model users will be motivate to walk and live healthier. Aiming to force the users to have a better lifestyle. IRL PARTNERSHIPS will take Walkers to buy healthy products for discounted prices. EXERCISE PROGRAMS for home exercises for everyone. NUTRITIONIST special program where users can get complete meal plans based on their blood type and daily activities.

WE ARE ALL STUCK IN A 'LABYRINTH' OF LIFE,WE ARE ALL LIVING BY SCHEDULES, WE ARE MISSING LIFE EXPERIENCES THAT WE CAN HAVE. LET'S GET OUT FROM THIS METAPHORICAL LABYRINTH TOGETHER AND A BUILD BRIGHT FUTURE.

'YOUR WALKS HAVE VALUE'
